section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents findings from Study 2 and Study 3, comparing the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) across online community samples of women and men. Study 3 involved a revision to Item 8 of the BAS-2. The section reports that the revised Item 8 did not significantly alter the internal consistency, factor structure, or measurement invariance of the BAS-2 between genders. Notably, both Study 2 and Study 3 found a negative correlation between BAS-2 scores and BMI (rs = −.38 for both women and men, p < .001), with no significant differences between the two studies.
